list_dir_list_files: list the contents of a directory up to 2 levels deep, excluding ignored patterns
list_dir_recurse: recurse into a directory tree listing files and subdirectories up to a specified max depth
list_dir_resolve_paths: resolve relative directory paths to absolute paths and return sorted results
should_ignore_name_filter: filter out files and directories matching ignore patterns like .git or __pycache__
list_dir_handle_errors: handle permission errors gracefully when traversing restricted directories
